enableTitle: Apply default size to pasted images
enableDesc: Only applies to newly pasted images; images that already have a width or height style are left untouched
widthDesc: Percentage of the editor width, 1-100. For example 20 fits about 5 images per row and 50 about 2, using the same inline gap convention as SiYuan
maxHeightDesc: 0 means no limit. When greater than 0, images scale down proportionally and are never stretched or upscaled
debugDesc: Log paste, scan, write and caret restore steps to the developer console for troubleshooting
invalidWidth: Width ratio must be a number between 1 and 100
saveFailed: Failed to save settings, please try again
